autocorrelation_method.entropy_rule: entropy of absolute normalized autocorrelation magnitudes in the bounded lag range
autocorrelation_method.input: R1 common trace after mean centering for autocorrelation only
autocorrelation_method.lag_range_rule: periods corresponding to 0.10--0.70 Hz, clipped to trace length
autocorrelation_method.normalization: divide by exact zero-lag energy; no epsilon
autocorrelation_method.periodicity_peak_rule: maximum normalized autocorrelation in the lag range; first maximum on ties
autocorrelation_method.short_trace_rule: typed unavailable when fewer than 64 samples or no bounded lag range

input_sampling_rate_rule: consume R1 output_sampling_rate_hz; current R1 candidate is 10 Hz
input_units: phase_like_radian; absolute displacement equivalence not claimed
reference_rule: reference channels are engineering diagnostics only and cannot tune this candidate
scale_preservation: autocorrelation is scale normalized only for periodicity descriptors; F1 absolute scale remains separate
sign_rule: preserve source sign; no sign flip; spectral power/autocorrelation descriptors are sign-invariant
